CustomField.description: Formula field used by EDU XB Calculator flow. Removed South Korea from APAC, split out AUS/NZ/Singapore/Malaysia from APAC, per SAL-3427 04/17/2024 - Ireland (Republic), Added Laos, Myanmar (Burma), Macau to match Marketo country names in order to enable Country/Territory Picklist
CustomField.formula:
IF(ISBLANK( ShippingCountry ), "None",
IF(CONTAINS("Australia", ShippingCountry), "AUS", IF(CONTAINS("New Zealand", ShippingCountry), "NZ",
IF(CONTAINS("United States", ShippingCountry), "USA",
IF(CONTAINS("Canada", ShippingCountry), "CAN", IF(CONTAINS("France", ShippingCountry), "FR", IF(CONTAINS("Germany", ShippingCountry), "DE", IF(CONTAINS("Ireland (Republic)",ShippingCountry), "IE", IF(CONTAINS("Japan", ShippingCountry), "JP", IF(CONTAINS("Spain", ShippingCountry), "ES", IF(CONTAINS("Switzerland", ShippingCountry), "CH", IF(CONTAINS("Malaysia", ShippingCountry), "MY", IF(CONTAINS("Singapore", ShippingCountry), "SG",
IF(CONTAINS("Mongolia:American Samoa:Antarctica:Bangladesh:Bhutan:Brunei:Cambodia:China:Christmas Island:Cocos (Keeling) Islands:Cook Islands:Fiji:French Polynesia:Guam:Heard Island and McDonald Islands:Hong Kong:Indonesia:Japan:Kiribati:Korea North:Laos:Macao:Maldives:Marshall Islands:Micronesia:Myanmar (Burma):Nauru:Nepal:New Caledonia:Niue:Norfolk Island:Northern Mariana Islands:Palau:Papua New Guinea:Philippines:Pitcairn:Samoa:Solomon Islands:Sri Lanka:Taiwan:Thailand:Tokelau:Tonga:Tuvalu:Vanuatu:Viet Nam:Wallis and Futuna:Afghanistan", ShippingCountry ), "APAC",
IF(CONTAINS("United Kingdom",ShippingCountry), "UK","Other")))))))))))))))
